threadDetails.description: Choose what the thread details card shows. You can also right-click the card.

threadsPanel.addProjectDescription: Leave empty to use “~/” when the Add Project browser opens.
threadsPanel.autoResumeDescription: Automatically resume threads when their usage limits reset. You can cancel auto-resume in each thread.
threadsPanel.compactIdleDescription: When to compact an idle Claude thread over 200,000 tokens: after you return, just before its prompt cache expires, or never. Each Claude provider can override this.
threadsPanel.ghqDescription: Clones go to github.com/owner/repo under the folder above, like ghq.
threadsPanel.keepPrDescription: Inactivity does not settle threads with a pull request. Merge and close still do.
threadsPanel.responseStreamingMixed: The selected targets use different streaming modes.
threadsPanel.settleDaysDescription: Any new activity un-settles a thread automatically.
threadsPanel.settleInactiveDescription: Sidebar threads with no activity for this long settle automatically.
threadsPanel.settleMergedDescription: Settle a thread when its pull request merges. Closed pull requests still settle automatically.
threadsPanel.snoozeLimitedDescription: Snooze threads until their usage limits reset. Enable auto-resume to continue the agent after the reset.
threadsPanel.streamingParagraphDescription: Each paragraph or code block appears as soon as it is complete.
threadsPanel.streamingTurnDescription: Text appears once the agent finishes its turn.
threadsPanel.textGenConnectEnvironment: Connect an environment to choose its text generation model.
threadsPanel.textGenDescription: For thread titles and other generated text. Source control has its own setting. Text generators from Providers also appear here.

uiLocale.description: Choose the language for menus, labels, and descriptions across the app.
uiLocale.footer: Interface language across your devices. Change it on any connected server and every client follows.
uiLocale.label: Interface language
uiLocale.title: Language

voiceCleanup.description: Model for transcript cleanup, such as a cheaper or faster one. When disabled, use the text generation model configured for this environment.
voiceCleanup.title: Cleanup model

voiceDictionary.addAria: Add a word or phrase to the {{label}}
voiceDictionary.addPlaceholder: Add words or phrases, separated by commas or line breaks
voiceDictionary.projectDescription: Saved with {{scope}} on its environment. Everyone who dictates in this project gets these spellings, along with their own dictionary. Project spellings win when the two overlap.
voiceDictionary.sharedDescription: Saved on the environment and used in every project there, along with each person’s own dictionary. Pick a project above to limit these words to one project.

voiceHardware.description: Auto uses the environment’s GPU when it has one.
voiceHardware.title: Hardware
voiceHardware.unloadChangeFailed: Could not change when the model unloads
voiceHardware.unloadDescription: Release the model’s memory on the environment after it sits idle.

voiceInput.chosenUnsupported: {{environment}} can’t transcribe audio locally. Choose a different destination.
voiceInput.dictationShortcutDescription: How the dictation shortcut starts and stops recording.
voiceInput.languageCloud: The cloud provider can detect your language automatically.
voiceInput.languageNoModel: Choose an environment above to see the languages its transcription model supports.
voiceInput.microphoneDescription: System default follows your operating system. Record a ten-second test and play it back here. Test audio stays on this device and is never transcribed.

shortcut.auto: Auto: press to toggle, hold to record
shortcut.toggle: Toggle: press to start, press again to stop

voiceInput.translateToEnglishDescription: Speak any language and get English text.

voiceModel.livePreviewTooltip: Shows words in your draft as you speak, before the recording finishes.
voiceModel.recommendedTooltip: A good default pick for the languages it covers.
voiceModel.stopUsingFile: Stop using your {{name}} file; the file stays on disk
voiceModel.translateTooltip: Can write English text from speech in another language. Turn on Translate to English to use it.

voiceModels.hint: Pick languages to see models that support all of them. Accuracy is word or character error rate: lower is better. Speed is the time to transcribe 30 seconds of audio on Handy’s benchmark {{tier}}.
voiceModels.linkFailed: Could not use a model from that path
voiceModels.linkPathAria: Path to a model file or folder already on this environment
voiceModels.linkPathPlaceholder: Already downloaded elsewhere? Paste the model file or folder path

voiceOptions.cleanupInstructionsDescription: Use the built-in instructions or write your own.
voiceOptions.cleanupTranscriptsDescription: Fixes punctuation, numbers, and spoken corrections with the cleanup model on the draft’s environment. Sends the transcript and nearby draft text, never audio.
voiceOptions.correctionCueDescription: The word or phrase you say to flag a correction, like “sorry” or “scratch that”. Cleanup applies the correction only where one is meant, and hears the cue as a hint.
voiceOptions.dictionaryDescription: Names and terms transcription should spell your way, saved on this device. Add an alias when it keeps hearing a term wrong. The name of the project you dictate in is also sent as a hint.
voiceOptions.removeFillerWordsDescription: Remove filler words like “um” and “uh” from transcripts.
voiceOptions.silenceFilteringDescription: Skip silence and other non-speech audio before transcription, keeping a short buffer so words aren’t cut off.

voiceTest.hint: Say a sentence in the language above. Cleanup is skipped, so you see exactly what the model heard. The transcript stays on this page.
voiceTest.hintShort: Say a sentence. Cleanup is skipped, so you see exactly what the model heard.
voiceTest.playbackFailed: Could not play this recording. Try recording again.
voiceTest.title: Test model
voiceTest.waitingForEnvironment: Waiting for the environment to connect

worktrees.startFromRemoteAria: Start new worktrees from remote by default
worktrees.startFromRemoteDescription: Uses the latest commit of the base branch’s tracked remote branch, even if its name differs. Otherwise uses the same-named branch on origin. Uses your local branch if that remote branch is missing.
